scope: Read-only source review of stable prepared future-use runner and existing exact export helper; no execution or qualification result

source_checks.frozen_input_and_tool_bindings: Runner/PINS SHA match; runner hashes itself, supplied include and all declared tools/helper/parser before and around jobs (lines78-92,111-126,162). Hashing source references does not execute them.
source_checks.exact_source_only_export: Actual pinned export_trial.py reads baseline Git ls-tree/cat-file blobs for CMake/LICENSE/include/src/bench/tests/tools, omits only historical pyc files, validates file set and git modes, changes only src/nnue_weights.inc and rejects an unchanged/other-shape/nonresidual include. Runner verifies baseline/H128/residual/changed-path/includeSHA and then full exported source bytes/modes (lines171-180).
source_checks.fresh_configurations: Exclusive output/build paths, C++20, explicit compiler/CMake/Make/Python and strict non-fast-math/no-contraction/no-LTO flags; fresh Release and separate RelWithDebInfo ASan/UBSan with non-PIE sanitizer link (lines182-215). Actual compile_commands and linker flags are inspected rather than inferred.
source_checks.complete_actual_tests: Exactly14 distinct original CTest names are required from discovery; actual ctest run must return0 and emit matching14-case JUnit withoutfailure/error/skipped plus fullpass summary (lines216-232). This is a future runtime gate, not a result observed by review.
source_checks.new_net_benchmark: New Release binary hash is frozen; first actual positive bench11 node signature is saved in exclusive FIRST-BENCH11.json, second fresh process must match; no old292545 signature assumption (lines233-252). Result makes no timing/NPS/Elo acceptance claim.
source_checks.owned_child_lifecycle: Each Popen uses a new process session. communicate timeout/exception kills that process group, communicates/reaps, records original command/stdin/stdout/stderr/rc/exception before raising; no retry loop (lines125-163). Current native UCI/ponder/book test child launches do not detach from their inherited group.
source_checks.failure_preservation: Exclusive writes retain original evidence; main failure records FAILED and explicitly requires investigation without force-pass source changes, automaticretry or promotion (lines267-273).
source_checks.candidate_and_core_binding_scope: No candidate exists yet at preparation time. Runner accepts explicit chosen include/SHA, proves exact original source plus that file, builds fresh native core and records new engine/core identities. It does not reuse or assume the old native core/binary hash.

required_external_invocation_binding.requirement: Root must verify the actual --inc path/--sha256 match its chosen frozen artifact and preserve a reference/hash to the final FREEZE.json in the invocation/controller receipt.
required_external_invocation_binding.reason: The intentionally reusable runner accepts an explicit include/SHA; it does not itself inspect FREEZE.json. This is no blocker under the root-owned planned invocation, but the prepared review alone does not prove a final candidate was selected.

limitations: Prepared source review is not a build, test, sanitizer, new-network bench, Windows validation, strength acceptance or Elo result.
Only runner/PINS/helper/parser bytes were read and hash-verified; no tool version command or tool/helper execution occurred.
Runtime success and actual process reaping must be established by later original logs/results.
